title: Full Vehicle System
objective: Complete vehicle gameplay over MIB-14 definitions/rules while preserving existing vehicle, Asset, travel, Character, combat, economy and Project owners.

scope.purpose: Complete vehicle gameplay over MIB-14 definitions/rules.
scope.completion_gate: Representative vehicles support complete ownership/crew/travel/maintenance workflows across live and async play.

selection_boundaries: MIB-14 remains vehicle/platform/base configuration, compatibility, slot/cargo/power capacity, crew bounds, D17 mutation-intent and maintenance/repair/upgrade Project-request planning authority.
D17 remains sole live Asset/vehicle identity, ownership, location, inventory/cargo placement, condition and state authority.
A8 shared-asset contracts retain vehicle operational-class/state vocabulary, station grants/command policy, vehicle resource projections and damage/capture transition semantics.
KFR-05 remains advisory qualification projection authority and does not grant station permission or executable action authority.
SMB-04/D28 remains journey/travel resolution authority and MIB-11/WCI remains World/navigation authority.
Existing Action/Effect/combat owners retain damage and combat-result authority.
APW-03/D26 remains Project/Activity and campaign-time authority, MIB-12 remains repair/upgrade/crafting definition authority, and MIB-13 remains current price/scarcity/settlement authority.
No fuel consumption, travel rate, damage value, repair cost, maintenance interval, upgrade yield or system-resource delta is inferred without explicit owner evidence.
No parallel vehicle, Asset, cargo, resource, journey, World, Project, economy or control ledger was created.
No autonomous scheduler, unattended progress, wall-clock advancement, provider activation, public/tester distribution, durable migration or SMB-07 implementation occurred.

implementation_plan.name: Derived vehicle workflow and replay contract

plan_adjustments.change: Removed verify_kfr_05.py from the SMB-06 active profile and enforced KFR-05 qualification/station-authority nonownership in SMB-06 acceptance plus tools/verify_smb_06.py.

next_action: SMB-06 is completed_verified. SMB-07 may be selected but must not be implemented until a later owner Continue governed-starts it.
